title: Towards responsible AI for education: Hybrid human-AI to confront the Elephant in the room

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the performance of mainstream deep knowledge tracing (DKT) models on both original (biased) and resampled (balanced) test sets to demonstrate how high accuracy is often an artifact of skewed answer distributions rather than genuine learning state modeling.

Comparing the predictive accuracy of symbolic, sub-symbolic, and Neural-Symbolic AI (NSAI) models on imbalanced educational datasets, specifically assessing their effectiveness at detecting underrepresented groups such as low-performing students.
